title: Hyaluronan like polysaccharide based nanodrugs with enhanced CD44 avidity for image-guided drug delivery to breast cancer
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2904-2914
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07975F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Chia-Wei Yang, A. K. M. Atique Ullah, Xuefei Huang
A theranostic nanodrug synthesized with a new hyaluronan derivative with enhanced CD44 affinity, salinomycin, and indocyanine green, has been shown to significantly enhance the treatment efficacy against breast cancer in a mouse model.
